title: The cached underlying function of Ext universe change
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], a module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and degree q, moduleAbelianUniverseMap is the underlying function of the existing coherentExtUniverseEquiv of [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison], from the small Ext group H(F,q) [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-naturality] to CoherentEtale.Source(X,F,q). Its concrete body is fun x => coherentExtUniverseEquiv(x). The irreducible function wrapper caches the bundled target type without comparing its additive-group instance with the raw Ext additive-group instance. No mathematical data is chosen or changed.
